description: LinkedIn job postings for a keyword and location from LinkedIn's public (logged-out) job search: job title, company, company page, location, posting date, 'actively hiring' flag, job ID and job URL, 10 per page. Job descriptions, salaries and applicant counts are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

keywords.description: Job title or skills, e.g. data engineer (required)

location.description: City, region or country, e.g. Berlin (default: worldwide)
